description: Search or bulk-download the Bar Standards Board's official Barristers' Register, browse disciplinary findings or interim suspensions, export BSB-regulated entities, or fetch barrister and finding URLs directly.

areasOfPractice.description: Restrict to barristers practising in ANY of these areas of law. Leave empty for all areas. Applies to mode=search (practising view only) and mode=authorisedBarristers.
areasOfPractice.title: Areas of practice filter (mode=search)

authorisedToConductLitigation.description: Filter by whether the barrister is authorised to conduct litigation. Applies to mode=search (practising view only) and mode=authorisedBarristers.
enumTitles: Not authorised to conduct litigation only
authorisedToConductLitigation.title: Authorised to conduct litigation (mode=search)

disciplinaryActionType.description: Restrict to findings with ANY of these sanction types. Leave empty for all types.
disciplinaryActionType.title: Disciplinary action type filter (mode=disciplinaryFindings)

entityStatus.description: Restrict to BSB-regulated entities with these authorisation statuses. Leave empty for all statuses.
entityStatus.title: Entity status filter (mode=entities)

fetchFullProfile.description: For mode=search and mode=disciplinaryFindings: fetch each record's full detail page for additional fields (chambers address, areas of practice, rights of audience, breach/offence details, etc). Uses one extra HTTP request per record. Not used by mode=authorisedBarristers (the CSV already contains the full record).
fetchFullProfile.title: Fetch full profile details

findingDateFrom.description: Start of the custom decision-date range, format `YYYY-MM-DD` (e.g. `2020-01-01`).
findingDateFrom.title: Finding date from (mode=disciplinaryFindings, findingDateRange=custom)

findingDateRange.description: Restrict findings to a decision-date window. `custom` uses `findingDateFrom`/`findingDateTo`. The window is applied to each finding's decision date.
findingDateRange.title: Finding date range (mode=disciplinaryFindings)

findingDateTo.description: End of the custom decision-date range, format `YYYY-MM-DD` (e.g. `2020-12-31`).
findingDateTo.title: Finding date to (mode=disciplinaryFindings, findingDateRange=custom)

findingStatus.description: Restrict to disciplinary findings with these statuses. Leave empty for all statuses.
findingStatus.title: Finding status filter (mode=disciplinaryFindings)

findingType.description: Restrict to findings from ANY of these hearing types. Leave empty for all types.
findingType.title: Hearing type filter (mode=disciplinaryFindings)

maxItems.description: Hard cap on the number of records emitted in this run. The full authorised-practising register currently has about 18,700 rows.
maxItems.title: Max items

mode.description: What to fetch from the Bar Standards Board register.
enumTitles: Search the Barristers' Register (by name / chambers)
Barristers with interim suspensions or conditions
mode.title: Mode

practisingStatus.description: Restrict to barristers with these practising statuses. Leave empty for all statuses. Applies to mode=search (practising view only) and mode=authorisedBarristers.
practisingStatus.title: Practising status filter (mode=search)

publicAccessRegistered.description: Filter by whether the barrister is registered to accept work directly from the public (Public Access scheme). Applies to mode=search (practising view only) and mode=authorisedBarristers.
publicAccessRegistered.title: Public Access registered (mode=search)

registerView.description: `Practising` = currently authorised practising barristers. `Sanctioned non-practising` = barristers disbarred or otherwise sanctioned who are no longer authorised to practise.
registerView.title: Register view (mode=search)

searchField.description: Whether `searchQuery` matches the barrister's name or their chambers/organisation (mode=search and mode=authorisedBarristers).
searchField.title: Search by (mode=search)

searchQuery.description: For mode=search: barrister name or chambers/organisation name (required). For mode=authorisedBarristers: optional name/chambers filter over the full register. For mode=disciplinaryFindings: optional barrister name filter — leave empty to browse all findings. For mode=entities: optional entity/trading name filter — leave empty to include all entities.
searchQuery.title: Search query (mode=search, authorisedBarristers, disciplinaryFindings, entities)

sortOrder.description: How to order the disciplinary findings listing.
sortOrder.title: Sort order (mode=disciplinaryFindings)

startUrls.description: Full barstandardsboard.org.uk barrister-register or disciplinary_finding URLs to fetch directly.
startUrls.title: Barrister / finding URLs (mode=byUrl)

title: Bar Standards Board Barrister Register Scraper Input
